jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create just the CENTRAL TORSO sprite of a mutated scorpion in the exact fleshy pale grey-pink Stalker family of the reference. Do not include any limbs, no legs, no arms, no pincers and no tail. Single connected torso only, strict orthographic TOP DOWN, anterior at TOP. Rounded triangular forebody carrying ONE large pale radial iris with one dark pupil, no face or human head. Short compact abdomen of three broad soft interlocking segments continuing downward, with a single small rear tail attachment stub. Eight walking-leg attachment zones are unobtrusive shallow side sockets, four left and four right, no protruding stumps. Two subtle front palp sockets. Proportions: whole torso about twice as tall as wide; front triangular plate widest, rear abdomen gradually narrower. Broad calm painted pinkish flesh volumes, light grey-pink upper surfaces and muted mauve recesses, simple dark contour like reference. Very little small texture, no dense veins, no glossy plastic. Gentle consistent diffuse volume only, no cast shadow or ground. Transparent background. Body centered vertically, ample margin. No labels or diagram lines. One torso, not a sheet, not a complete scorpion.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image1, the existing connected bloody carcass for this fictional horror monster. Change ONLY THE SMALL HEAD at the left of the torso to match the canonical head design in image2: short broad head with eight small dark spider eyes, four on each side, and ONE pair of closed ivory chelicerae/mandibles at the left-facing snout. The eyes are dead, dull black and partially blood-smeared. Keep the same head/neck attachment location and same overall head scale as image1. Preserve image1's EXACT canvas, framing, corpse arrangement, limb count, every existing hand/foot and claw, all wounds and the outer body pose. Keep two long front arms with three claws each and two short hind feet with three main claws plus one side claw across the complete composition. Do not create any extra limbs, heads or mandibles. Preserve grey-mauve fleshy palette. This is the same creature after death; no new dynamic pose or lighting. No floor, NO added blood puddle painted underneath, no cast shadow, genuine transparent background. One full static remains sprite. No text or marks.
